jobs.name: Morning attention sweep
jobs.description: Daily 6:30 AM MT: surface P1 attention, fix priority inversion by moving flexible P3 then P1 work to Reschedule (no direct calendar edits), goals check. Handlers place slots.

payload.message:
Use skills: ubi_trello_ops, ubi_calendar_scheduling.

Read first:
- /home/node/.openclaw/agent-runtime/ubi/scripts/USER.md (core goals)
- /home/node/.openclaw/agent-runtime/ubi/scripts/Docs/Reports/05-06-2026/calendar_priority_audit_2026-05-06.md (protected blocks + inversion rules)
- /home/node/.openclaw/agent-runtime/ubi/scripts/Docs/Reports/05-23-2026/morning_attention_sweep_spec.md (this job)

Morning attention sweep — four outcomes:

1) PRIORITY ATTENTION
- Surface P1 (then P2) items Adriel should see today or tomorrow: Backlog, Reschedule, Scheduled without a sensible near-term calendar block, overdue Scheduled (gateway may have commented), Adriel Focus awaiting decision.
- No full-board cleanup; only priority-relevant cards.

2) CALENDAR vs PRIORITY (next 7 days) — TRELLO ONLY, NO CALENDAR EDITS
- You may READ Google Calendar (gog) and Trello (gateway) to detect inversion: flexible P3 work blocks on near-term days while P1 work lacks a good block this week.
- Priority from card titles (P1/P2/P3) on Trello-linked events.
- Do not create, update, move, or delete Google Calendar events in this job. Never duplicate events.
- Safe fix (only allowed action): use the Trello gateway to move cards to the Reschedule list in this order:
  (a) All eligible flexible P3 work on Scheduled (or blocking near-term time) to Reschedule first.
  (b) Then P1 work that needs a slot to Reschedule.
- handle_reschedule.mjs (queue worker) places calendar slots deterministically (P3 about +5 days, P1 about +1 day). Do not invent manual times.

Never move to Reschedule for rebalance (protected — calendar must stay):
- Any card on the Routine list
- Work block, shared/family calendar visibility, dog walk, sciatica, gym/Planet Fitness/swim, OT/accountability, Sunday reset, drive buffers, therapy, antacid, date/relationship time, or titles matching those routines
- Adriel Focus (unless Adriel explicitly asked for that exact move)

If unsure whether a card is flexible work vs protected routine, leave it alone.

Optional: one Trello comment on a summary/backlog card listing what you moved (Trello only; no Telegram for routine moves).

3) GOALS
- For each USER.md core goal, briefly: on track / stalled / no time this week. If stalled, name the smallest next Trello action (not a calendar edit).

4) CALENDAR CONFLICTS (next 7 days)
- Using gog, scan the next 7 days for overlapping calendar events (any two events whose time ranges intersect on the same calendar).
- Ignore all-day events and events marked as free/transparent.
- If conflicts exist, list them in the Telegram message: date, time range, both event titles.
- Do not move or edit any events — surface only.

Environment (every exec):
set -a; source /home/node/.openclaw/agent-runtime/ubi/scripts/trello_bridge/.env; set +a
export TRELLO_GATEWAY_URL TRELLO_GATEWAY_KEY

For calendar READS only (no writes):
export GOG_KEYRING_PASSWORD="$(cat /home/node/.openclaw/credentials/gog-keyring-password)"
export PATH="/home/node/.openclaw/tools/gogcli:$PATH"

Safety: no applications submitted, external messages, spend, PII exposure, production/credential changes, Browserbase, or Adriel Focus moves unless Adriel explicitly asked.

Telegram only if:
(a) P1 work still has no viable path after you moved cards to Reschedule (handlers may still be running — note if queue may be behind),
(b) a core goal is stalled with no week plan,
(c) a real decision is needed,
(d) you could not use gateway/Trello safely, or
(e) calendar conflicts exist.

Otherwise reply exactly NO_REPLY.

Use skills: ubi_nightly_job_search, ubi_job_applications, ubi_trello_ops.

Read: /home/node/.openclaw/agent-runtime/ubi/scripts/skills/ubi-nightly-job-search/SKILL.md

Environment (every exec):
set -a; source /home/node/.openclaw/agent-runtime/ubi/scripts/trello_bridge/.env; set +a
export TRELLO_GATEWAY_URL TRELLO_GATEWAY_KEY

Nightly job search — one agent run (Option B: no webhook; you complete Trello intake in this run).

## Phase 1 — Search and packages

1. Review prior reports/shortlists under Docs/Reports/ (especially job_search_shortlist.md and any nightly_job_search_report_*.md) to avoid stale/duplicate leads.
2. Find fresh QA/junior developer roles: Denver/Boulder/Colorado hybrid or Remote US, target ~$65k+ (see ubi_job_applications).
3. Write Docs/Reports/YYYY-MM-DD/nightly_job_search_report_YYYY-MM-DD.md with sources, fit scores, rejects.
4. For the best 1–3 live matches, write packages under job_applications/packages/YYYY-MM-DD/ — status: Ready for Adriel review, not submitted.

## Phase 2 — Trello per package (gateway + intake script)

For each package, do **not** use trello_create_card.mjs (legacy direct API). Run:

node /home/node/.openclaw/agent-runtime/ubi/scripts/scripts/trello/active/job_application_review_card_intake.mjs \
  --company "Company Name" \
  --role "Role Title" \
  --apply-url "https://..." \
  --package-path "/home/node/.openclaw/agent-runtime/ubi/scripts/job_applications/packages/YYYY-MM-DD/file.md" \
  --report-path "/home/node/.openclaw/agent-runtime/ubi/scripts/Docs/Reports/YYYY-MM-DD/nightly_job_search_report_YYYY-MM-DD.md" \
  --fit-score 8 \
  --research "Brief fit summary from your search."

That script applies the **same Backlog intake template** as the bridge hook (adapted for job applications):

- Original Request → Research → Next steps → Peer Review (N/A for Marcos) → Work completed
- Styles card (cover, priority label, assign Adriel)
- Sets Time Needed (default 45 min)
- Comments @adriellopez1 with links
- Moves to **Reschedule** → queue worker runs handle_reschedule.mjs → **P2** calendar block → Scheduled

Agent-created cards do **not** wake a second Ubi session; this script replaces that hook path.

## Safety

Never submit applications, pay, create accounts, message recruiters, use Browserbase, or edit calendar directly in this job.

If no good roles: report only, reply exactly NO_REPLY unless a real blocker or decision.

If script/Trello fails: comment blocker on an existing job-search card or Telegram briefly, then report the error.

jobs.description: Nightly 1:00 AM MT: deep pass — trim MEMORY.md, archive aged entries, promote cross-agent facts, reverse-scan wiki/ubi/ for promotable rules. Always Telegram summary.

payload.message:
Nightly memory audit — deep pass.

Workspace: /home/node/.openclaw/agent-vault/ubi/

## Retention rules

Keep in MEMORY.md:
- Active preferences and rules applied every session
- Anything still referenced in the last 30 days

Promote to raw-input/ as ubi-YYYY-MM-DD-{slug}.md:
- Cross-agent facts
- Completed project outcomes
- Infra or runbook-shaped content
- Long rule sets (leave a one-line pointer in MEMORY.md)

Remove or archive:
- Past calendar dates
- One-off session debugging notes
- Superseded rules
- Completed migrations

## Steps

1. Scan memory/ for notes from the past 24 hours. Trim stale and superseded lines from MEMORY.md.
2. Create raw-input/ drops for any promotions.
3. Move pruned MEMORY.md entries verbatim to `memory/archive-{YYYY-MM-DD}.md` before removing them from the active file. Copy raw — do not summarize. One entry per line, prefixed with today's date. Only then remove them from MEMORY.md.
4. Review memory/ files older than 30 days; remove one-offs that never promoted.
5. Reverse-scan wiki/ubi/ for pages containing operational rules or principles not yet in MEMORY.md. Propose additions via Telegram — do not auto-apply.
6. Surface any `gap-unresolvable:` entries found in MEMORY.md in the Telegram summary — these require operator review.
7. Send a brief Telegram summary: files touched, promotions created, archive entries moved, wiki rules found, gap-unresolvable items.

## Guardrails

- Do not edit wiki/ directly.
- Do not run Trello or calendar sweeps.
- Do not expose secrets in promotions.
- Do not auto-apply wiki-sourced rules to MEMORY.md — propose via Telegram only.

jobs.name: Ubi daily skill generation
jobs.description: Daily 2:00 AM MT: review recent wiki/ubi/ pages for repeatable procedures; generate at most one auto skill per day using openclaw-skill-authoring. Cap: 10 auto skills; 3-day immunity on new skills.

payload.message:
Daily skill generation pass for Ubi.

Skill pool: `/home/node/.openclaw/agent-vault/ubi/skills/`

## Step 1 — Find a pattern worth capturing

Check both sources and pick the strongest candidate:

**A) MEMORY.md gap scan (highest priority)**
Read `/home/node/.openclaw/agent-vault/ubi/MEMORY.md`. Grep for lines starting with `gap:` — these are self-identified failures and repeated lookups the agent flagged during live sessions. Each `gap:` line is a direct request for a skill. Prefer these above all other sources.

Sort gap: candidates by frequency descending — gap(3) before gap(2) before gap: (treat absent counter as 1). Evaluate the highest-frequency candidate first.

**B) Recent wiki/ubi/**
Scan `wiki pages` for pages produced in the last 7 days. Look for repeatable multi-step procedures not already covered by an existing skill.

Prefer A over B when both yield candidates — skills born from self-identified gaps have higher long-term value than skills extracted from completed research.

If neither source yields a candidate → reply exactly NO_REPLY.

## Step 1.5 — Episodic context lookup

Run: qmd search memory/ "{gap area keywords}" --limit 3

Read the top results fully. If results show this gap was previously addressed (skill was generated, a workaround was documented, or it was marked gap-unresolvable:), carry that context forward into Step 3.5. If no results or results are unrelated, proceed without episodic context.

## Step 2 — Check the pool cap

Count SKILL.md files with `origin: auto` frontmatter under the skill pool.
- If count < 10: proceed to create.
- If count = 10: find the skill with the lowest `read_count` that was `generated` more than 3 days ago. If multiple tie, pick the oldest `generated` date. If all are within the 3-day immunity window → reply NO_REPLY and retry tomorrow.
- Delete the evicted skill folder before writing the new one.
- Append the evicted skill to `memory/evicted-skills.md`: `- {skill-name} | {description, max 120 chars} | evicted: {YYYY-MM-DD} | generated: {YYYY-MM-DD}`

Before proceeding to Step 3, check `memory/evicted-skills.md`. If the top gap candidate matches a skill name evicted within the last 30 days, skip that candidate and try the next. If no candidates remain, reply NO_REPLY.

## Step 3 — Write the skill

Use skill: openclaw-skill-authoring. Create `{skillPool}/{skill-name}/SKILL.md` with the auto-generated frontmatter shape:

```yaml
---
name: skill-name
description: What the skill does and when to use it.
origin: auto
generated: YYYY-MM-DD
read_count: 0
last_read: null
---
```

Keep the body under 200 lines. Add a `references/` file only if the skill genuinely needs detail beyond the body.

Never generate more than one skill per run. Never create a skill that duplicates an existing one.

## Step 3.5 — Validate before writing

Before writing the skill file to disk, answer in one sentence: "Would an agent who read this skill at the start of the session have avoided the gap?"

- Yes → write the skill.
- No → discard the draft. Rewrite the gap entry in MEMORY.md as: `gap-unresolvable: [area] — [reason] — unresolvable because: [one sentence]`. Do not count this as the day's skill. Try the next gap candidate if one exists.

## Step 4 — Clean up the gap entry

If the skill was generated from a `gap:` entry in MEMORY.md, remove that line from MEMORY.md now. The gap has been addressed — leaving it would cause the cron to re-evaluate it tomorrow. Do not remove `gap-unresolvable:` entries — these are terminal state and intentionally left in place.

jobs.description: Nightly 8:00 PM MT: grow wiki/ubi/ with one sourced page on a topic not yet covered.

payload.message:
Nightly research pass for Ubi.

Grow wiki/ubi/ with one sourced page on a topic not yet covered.
Do not run Trello sweeps, calendar checks, or maintenance work.

## Step 1 — Find a gap

Read /home/node/.openclaw/agent-vault/wiki/ubi/ubi-index.md and scan page titles under wiki/ubi/. Find a topic not yet covered — an angle left open by an existing page, a concept mentioned but never written up, or a craft area (delegation, communication, decision-making, productivity) with a thin or missing page.

Run: qmd search wiki/ubi/ "{2-3 terms from your chosen topic}" --limit 2
Read the top results fully before proceeding. Don't repeat what's already there.

If the wiki has no meaningful gap today → reply NO_REPLY.

## Step 2 — Research with sources

Every claim must be grounded in at least 3 external sources.
